title: Java 28 - Better Language, Better APIs, Better Runtime

content:
Java 25 is the latest release with wide-ranging long-term support. It's a doozy and Java 26 to 28 followed hot on its heels.

Java 25 is the latest release with wide-ranging long-term support. It's a doozy but new releases followed hot on its heels and delivered a lot, particularly Java 28:

  • from module imports to improved pattern matching
  • from structured concurrency to PEM and HTTP/3
  • from incubating lazy constants and a JSON API to previewing primitive patterns and value classes (!)
  • from faster launches and better performance to quantum-resistant encryption

There are plenty of features in the language, API, and runtime to discuss - whether new, improved, or finalized. So let's go over them!
